_doc: The on-device IPC contract between the Cloud-IDE hub and Cloud-SuperApp (and between the hub and each fork exporter). THE source of truth: hub/SuperApp/fork constants mirror this file; `./build.sh verify-contract` validates it against ide-ipc-v1.schema.json. Only file URIs + metadata cross the boundary — file CONTENT never does; full content is reached via the openFile/revealInFiles AIDL actions (deep link into the owning app). version is breaking: never edit v1 in place, add v2.

tables._doc: ContentProvider tables. The hub exposes them under `authority`; each fork exporter exposes the tables IT owns under its own authority (com.diegonmarcos.ide.<domain>.provider) and the hub UNIONs them. Not every fork owns every table (editor → workspaces/recent_files/git_repos; files → recent_files/transfers; utils → storage_summary); a fork that doesn't own a table simply returns no rows and is skipped. `_ts`/`_uri` columns: epoch-millis longs / content-or-file URIs. `_bytes` columns are longs.

aidl._doc: Bound service for actions + push callbacks (the write/live half the read-only ContentProvider can't do). Gated by the same signature permission. Survives Doze (bound service, not a socket). Method/callback signatures here are mirrored exactly in hub/src/main/aidl/.

states._doc: Allowed values. transfer = transfers.state / onTransferStateChanged; scan = storage_summary scan lifecycle / onStorageScanComplete.
